s1.text: One hidden Spark. Where will you look?
s1.phonemes: wˈʌn hˈɪdən spˈɑːɹk. wˌɛɹ wɪl juː lˈʊk?

s2.text: Every hunt starts with a clue. Read it closely, and follow where it leads.
s2.phonemes: ˈɛvɹi hˈʌnt stˈɑːɹts wɪð ɐ klˈuː. ɹˈiːd ɪt klˈoʊsli, ænd fˈɑːloʊ wˌɛɹ ɪt lˈiːdz.

s3.text: Search the map. Explore the workspaces. Follow the clue until the right place comes into view.
s3.phonemes: sˈɜːtʃ ðə mˈæp. ɛksplˈɔːɹ ðə wˈɜːkspeɪsᵻz. fˈɑːloʊ ðə klˈuː ʌntˈɪl ðə ɹˈaɪt plˈeɪs kˈʌmz ˌɪntʊ vjˈuː.

s4.text: There it is. Spark found. Now see what your hunt could unlock.
s4.phonemes: ðɛɹ ɪɾ ˈɪz. spˈɑːɹk fˈaʊnd. nˈaʊ sˈiː wʌt jʊɹ hˈʌnt kʊd ʌnlˈɑːk.

s5.text: Your next hunt could unlock an Amazon gift card. Eligibility and terms apply.
s5.phonemes: jʊɹ nˈɛkst hˈʌnt kʊd ʌnlˈɑːk ɐn ˈæmɐzˌɑːn ɡˈɪft kˈɑːɹd. ˌɛlɪdʒəbˈɪlᵻɾi ænd tˈɜːmz ɐplˈaɪ.

s6.text: Where’s your Spark hiding? Enter the hunt with GoFloaters.
s6.phonemes: wˌɛɹz jʊɹ spˈɑːɹk hˈaɪdɪŋ? ˈɛntɚ ðə hˈʌnt wɪð ɡˈoʊflˌoʊtɚz.
